'''Noe'ha'on''' was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Piryn Shar sector/Legends|Piryn Shar sector]]. Its [[Species/Legends|fauna]] included [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]]&mdash;ferocious, [[Worm/Legends|worm]]-like [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Diet/Legends|predators]]. Noe'ha'on also had large fossil beds rich with the preserved remains of organisms.

The [[Noehon]]s were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Noe'ha'on. They lived in communities called [[weld]]s and were at an industrial level of technology, harvesting their homeworld's natural resources and crafting several materials and substances from them.

Noe'ha'on lay along the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], and it served as a frequent stopping point for [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. Off-world traders introduced the Noehons to more advanced weaponry, leading to heightened inter-tribal violence and anarchy on their homeworld. Eventually, Noe'ha'on became a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
Noe'ha'on was a distant [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG12" /> located in the [[Noe'ha'on system/Legends|Noe'ha'on system]], a part of the [[Piryn Shar sector/Legends|Piryn Shar sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC Noehaon" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] connected it to the [[Natalon system/Legends|Natalon system]] as well as the [[New Balosar system/Legends|New Balosar system]]<ref name="TEA Noehaon" /> in the [[Arc d'Stot sector/Legends|Arc d'Stot sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

A [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world,<ref name="UAA" /> Noe'ha'on also featured [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]],<ref name="FF" /> in which [[Color/Legends|pink]]-colored mud-clay could be found.<ref name="RPG2ERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> In addition, the planet's surface included large fossil beds, where many preserved remains of Noe'ha'on's wildlife were located.<ref name="Fossil Records" />

Noe'ha'on was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]],<ref name="CSWE klorslug" /> an aggressive [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Poison/Legends|venomous]], [[Worm/Legends|worm]]-like swamp [[Diet/Legends|predators]].<ref name="RPG2ERE" /> K'lor'slugs could already be found off-world a [[3743 BBY|century]] before the outbreak of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}}</ref> Poisonous [[Insect/Legends|insects]] also populated Noe'ha'on, and [[Disease/Legends|diseases]] could be contracted in the planet's wilderness.<ref name="GG12" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date TOR">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Fossil Records" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> several expeditions were sent to Noe'ha'on to recover fossils, with the planet's fossil beds eventually becoming littered with the tools of those failed ventures. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual dispatched a companion to Noe'ha'on, where the latter found an abandoned [[paleontologist]]s' camp and scavenged what had been left behind there.<ref name="Fossil Records" />
{{Endgame}}

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Noe'ha'on was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="TEA Noehaon" /> with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] establishing first contact with the native [[Noehon]] species at some point.<ref name="GG12" /> The planet fell within the borders of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA Noehaon" /> During the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Nineteenth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending Noe'ha'on's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Between 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Noe'ha'on was incorporated into the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

{{RPGseed}}
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of individuals became interested in obtaining and [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] a valuable medicinal drug only available on Noe'ha'on. The individuals underwent a dangerous and uncomfortable journey to the planet, where they faced capture by a dominant Noehon [[Gender/Legends|male]].<ref name="GG12" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Noehon}}
[[File:Noehon_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Noehons were native to Noe'ha'on.]]
Noe'ha'on was inhabited by the Noehons, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]]. They were small, four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] bipeds who spoke the [[Noehonese]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. Noehons lived in [[weld]]s, isolated communities whose membership could range from a few hundred to 10,000 individuals.<ref name="UAA" /> The population of the Noe'ha'on [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 100 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA Noehaon" />

Eventually, the Noehon society reached industrial level of technology. The insectoids harvested and refined their homeworld's natural resources and manufactured [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]] products, glues, [[Spice/Legends|spices]], [[Plant/Legends|wood-fiber]] products, and specialty [[Paper/Legends|paper]] goods. Due to the potent natural healing agents present in Noe'ha'on's jungles, the Noehons also crafted relatively advanced medicines. To obtain energy, Noehons [[Fire/Legends|burned]] [[petroleum]], [[Coal/Legends|coal]], and wood. The Noehon weapons were usually inaccurate rapid-fire projectile devices.<ref name="GG12" />

Noe'ha'on was frequently visited by off-worlders,<ref name="UAA" /> serving as a regular stopping point for several [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] merchants. Unscrupulous, independent<ref name="GG12" /> [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] traders introduced the natives to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]. As a result, Noehon tribal rivalries transformed into full-scale wars between the welds that would continue until one of the sides in the conflict was annihilated.<ref name="UAA" /> Another effect of the inter-weld violence was that the reigning anarchy prevented the Noehons from ever developing space-flight technology of their own.<ref name="GG12" /> However, the off-world visitors were willing to transport the Noehons off Noe'ha'on for a price, allowing<ref name="UAA" /> a small fraction of<ref name="GG12" /> the species to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] other worlds in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Locations==
A camp used by paleontologists was located near the fossil beds on Noe'ha'on.<ref name="Fossil Records" /> By 3643 BBY,<ref name="Date TOR" /> the camp had been abandoned, with functional equipment and a carefully-cleaned fossil left behind.<ref name="Fossil Records" />

==Behind the scenes==
Noe'ha'on was created by [[Lisa Smedman]] and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book includes a [[roleplaying game]] adventure seed set on Noe'ha'on. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Noe'ha'on system, and therefore the planet Noe'ha'on, in grid square K-16.<ref name="TEA Noehaon" />

Noe'ha'on was later mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, players could assign their companions on<ref name="Fossil Records" /> two different Crew Skill missions to visit Noe'ha'on. In the Bioanalysis mission "The K'lor'slug Expedition," [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Skatheris]] was studying k'lor'slugs in their native habitat. If particularly successful, the companions would help the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] develop an anti-k'lor'slug serum.<ref name="Klorslug Expedition">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The K'lor'slug Expedition}}</ref> With the [[2016]]<ref name="Update4.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes}}</ref> Game Update 4.1, however, the text of the relevant mission&mdash;renamed "The Dianoga Expedition"&mdash;was changed to instead state that "[[Professor/Legends|Professor]]" Skatheris was studying the [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] creatures on [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]].<ref name="Dianoga Expedition">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Dianoga Expedition}}</ref> In addition, the information regarding the outcome of the Scavenging mission "Fossil Records" was eventually removed from the game.<ref name="Fossil Records" />
